scientific_choices.choice: Local paper3.5/Algorithm2 uses context scores and whole-image DeepSolo fallback; Table5 nominal TotalText78.4/79.8 are comparison markers only, not a verified equivalent metric.

Reuse immutable audited425 YOLO640/PARSeq word sets, all38 prior score families, independent frozen probes and complete ViTAEv2-S+TextOCR DeepSolo branches, with original TRAIN80/45/TEST300 partition and care denominators983/2204.

Study per-image actual wordF1 quality targets50..100%. Fractions of accepted images reaching that target, aggregate accepted-word F1, rejected DeepSolo F1 and final microF1/TN0 are distinct. No image-weighted approximation; sum actual branch counts.

Thirteen new frozen rules use native mean/quantile/harmonic confidence, mean CLIP rank, per-word geometric agreement with perturbed-crop stability, coverage-based proxy2precision*coverage/(1+coverage), cross-scale agreement, MPNet combination and overlap penalty. Confidence/ranks/coverage are uncalibrated proxies, not ground truth or a certified F1 estimator. No learned weights or new model inference/training.

Predeclare all families before new TEST derived features. For each quality target/purity/objective, select family/candidate cut onTRAIN80, independently calibrate scalar cut onTRAIN45. Require at least20% bypass and5 accepted calibration cases. Objectives maximize coverage or combined microF1 subject to empirical good-image purity. No qualifying cut means explicit all-image fallback, ineligible as a nontrivial routing win.

For each fixed GT-free rank budget, choose family only onTRAIN80 by maximum good-image count, then combinedF1 and declared order. Report all transferred family policies, TRAIN-selected policies and full descriptive score curves. TEST post-hoc maxima are explicitly labeled and never deployed.

GT threshold and best branch-choice oracles are diagnostic upper bounds, never inferable routing rules. Bootstrap selected fixed gates with paired image counts, no refitting/multiplicity correction. No official paper superiority claim from local lexical F1.

Historically explored TEST, repeated TRAIN use,45-case calibration, DeepSolo TRAIN fine-tuning, official paper metric/checkpoints/ignore and whole-pipeline latency limit claims. A higher image-quality target need not improve final microF1; accepting fewer images alone does not establish a better router.
